title: Nashville Food Tour - Broadway and Backstreets - Walking
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the energy, flavor, and history of Lower Broadway with the Flavor Walk Nashville Broadway Downtown Food Tour. This guided walking tour takes you through the heart of downtown Nashville, where iconic honky-tonks, historic landmarks, and locally loved restaurants come together in one unforgettable culinary experience.

Enjoy hand-selected tastings that showcase the best of Music City—from Southern staples to modern bites—while your local guide shares the rich stories behind Nashville’s famous strip. Whether you’re visiting for the first time or rediscovering the city you love, the Broadway Downtown Tour with Flavor Walk Nashville is the perfect way to eat, explore, and experience downtown like a true insider.

Overview:
- Duration: 2-3 hours of guided exploration
- Small groups of 2-12 guests for an intimate experience
- Includes multiple food stops and an alcoholic beverage
- Family-friendly tours suitable for all ages
